schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: TWO THINGS LIVE HERE, AND THE 2026-08-05 RULING SEPARATED THEM. (1) THE ENGINE (engine.py, ticket engine-runs-one-block, 2026-08-02) — this is the LEARNING BLOCK's own inner loop: input -> candidates loop -> evaluation loop -> decide or escalate -> output, instantiated from a data-only block spec (the spec carries the block's difference; the engine is branchless about blocks, and a block-specific branch in engine code falsifies the design). The candidates loop generates; the evaluation loop kills against the CONSTRAINING QUESTIONS and leaves survivors. These are the anatomy's TWO DISTINCT LOOPS — Akien named them as two and could not recall their jobs; the built code had them right. Every run writes its full state log through the trace machinery consumer-typed 'training': input, candidates, the constraint that killed each loser, why the winner won, what escalated and to where — so the reasoning a session used to hold in attention lands in a record any model can read back (the 2026-08-02 lived symptom: 'as soon as we switch from fable to opus, we start spiralling down'). (2) THE SHARED GATE MACHINERY every caller imports — built once, the single-door move: skills declare contracts, they do not build refusal. Five pieces, and WHICH LAYER EACH BELONGS TO IS THE PART THAT WAS WRONG UNTIL 2026-08-05: the DOOR (a declarable input contract; insufficient shape refused with EVERY lack named on the first pass, the refusal itself traced) — BLOCK-GENERAL, it is Akien's 'send a task back if the inputs are not sufficient AT ALL STEPS'; the TRACE (every firing recorded, green included, consumer-typed at write — debug|training|tree-primary; no consumer named, no trace written; debug records expire at 30 days, swept by the NEXT WRITE — the write is the event, nothing resident, no clock) — BLOCK-GENERAL, it is how a run leaves a record; the FINDING (the exit-time bullet list, every bullet stratum-tagged code|tree|hex, and hex mintable ONLY via the injected seam — provenance cannot be invented) — THE INSPECTOR'S OUTPUT SLOT, not an organ of a block: an inspector's KB is a list of things to measure, so its output takes this shape. A block that is not an inspector emits no finding; the VERDICT (Akien's approve/disprove/question captured with his words verbatim as a gate-record conforming to CairnCommons/learning/'s v0 format — the sole write path into that store from this component; approvals recorded with the same fidelity as disprovals, because greens are the denominator) — THE HUMAN GATE ON AN INSPECTOR, a separate matter from the block it stands in front of; the DIAL (a pure projection over the trace: firings, send-backs, approvals, disproves, questions, match rate — computed on read, stores nothing, mutates nothing) — THE DELEGATION MACHINERY around that gate. THE CODE IS UNCHANGED BY THIS RULING; what changed is the claim about what it IS. There is no 'five-organ Learning Block anatomy' — see node_class and filed_edge (k). THE DOOR OPENS ON A PROOF RECORD (2026-08-13, Akien: "EVERYTHING ALWAYS PROVED AND LISTING WHAT IT PROVED ... SAME PATTERN EVERYWHERE"). ``inspect_input`` returns one entry per REQUIRED FIELD THE CONTRACT DECLARES, EXPECTED beside ACTUAL, passes included, and ``check_input`` survives as a VIEW over its mismatches — derived, never parallel. The record's LENGTH is the contract's size, so a field that stops being required makes it SHORTER rather than cleaner: the lack list was the same empty thing whether every declared field arrived or ``requires`` had been quietly emptied upstream. THE RECORD RIDES BOTH TRACES: a ``door_pass`` used to name only the fields that ARRIVED and could not say which checks RAN, which is that same silence surviving on the green side of a component whose whole job is to make firings countable. And the JUDGE ENTRY IS GUARDED, which is the distinction the build inspector's judges cannot yet draw: ``extra_lacks=None`` means no semantic judge ran and no entry is appended (a check that did not run is ABSENT, not passed), while ``extra_lacks=[]`` means a judge RAN and was satisfied — a different fact, and it gets an entry saying so.
why: Akien, 2026-08-01, the morning the design settled: 'our workflow itself must have the same hard gates, built of learning blocks, everywhere... learning blocks can send a task or whatever back if the inputs are not sufficient AT ALL STEPS. that has been the problem all along. when we have that, there's nothing for you to skate with.' And the gate mechanism, his verbatim: 'we start with me owning all gates and i approve the pass... a bullet list finding from an inspector for that step that learns what --I-- will gate. eventually i delegate it.' The Leah amendment closed the loop's arithmetic: 'even not-surprising-green-feedback is a metricable feedback' — surprise routes the errors up, greens make the rates computable. One primitive rather than N bespoke gates is the db_domain pattern; the full arc, challenge pass, and settlement: CairnCommons/notes/held-learning-blocks-everywhere.json.

feedback.why: A SELF-ROUTE, AND THE REASON IS A LIMIT OF THE SHAPE, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN. This door inspects its CALLER'S payload against the block's contract — required_field_arrived:<field> and the_callers_judge_finds_nothing. Akien's design for exactly this, 2026-08-01: 'learning blocks can send a task or whatever back if the inputs are not sufficient AT ALL STEPS. that has been the problem all along.' So the true destination is THE CALLER, which is known at firing time and cannot be spelled in a static declaration. The honest static address is this one: every entry already carries the contract's own `why` for the field, so a field that keeps arriving empty indicts the contract that demanded it, and the contract is here. A caller-returned route is a change to the shape and Akien's to make, not a token this charter quietly coins — the same reservation tools/feedback made for per-finding routing. · filed as edge (f) on cairn/tools/feedback

invoke: Engine: `from cairn.machines.learning_block.engine import run_block, answers_five_questions, rejected_count` — `run_block(spec, payload)` (one run, refuse-or-reason, the state log written in the same act; DoorRefused carries every lack); a block's spec berths BESIDE ITS OWN COMPONENT as `block_spec.json` (first tenant: cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/block_spec.json). Inspectors (the PROOF RECORD half, 2026-08-13): `inspect_spec(spec)` and `inspect_state_log(record)` return one entry per check that RAN, EXPECTED beside ACTUAL, passes included; `answers_five_questions` is the VIEW over the second, and `run_block` writes both doors' records into the landed run's state log as well as into every send-back. Organs: `from cairn.machines.learning_block import learning_block as lb` — `lb.declare_contract(block, {field: why})` · `lb.fire_door(contract, payload)` (traced pass, or DoorRefused carrying every lack) · `lb.write_trace(block, event, consumer, data)` · `lb.traced(block, op)` (THE TRACE WIRE, a context manager: retrofit an existing door in one line — clean exit traces door_pass, an exception traces send_back with the lack named and re-raises) · `lb.emit_finding(block, bullets, hex_source=None)` · `lb.record_verdict(gate, finding, signal, verbatim, session=...)` · `lb.dial(block)`. From BASH: `python3 -m cairn.machines.learning_block trace <block> <door_pass|send_back> <op> [lack ...]` and `... dial <block>` — the shell door two of the first four wired components required. Prove: `python3 cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block.py` (exit 0 = green). Roots injectable: `CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT` (traces; default ~/.cairn/devices/learning_block/0/traces) and `CAIRN_ROOTS_PARENT` (commons discovery for the verdict store) — every proof call passes explicit roots and never touches the live stores. · `lb.pending_findings(gate=None)` (the gate queue: findings no approve/disprove has answered — pure read) · shell: `cairn recordverdict` (bare = list the gate; `"Approved - …"` = judge the single pending; `<block-or-id> [signal] "<words>"` = multi-flight). The door's original stance that verdicts stay python-side is REVISED (2026-08-01, ticket recordverdict-cli-door): the verdict is the one organ whose caller is a human shell.
for_whom: AKIEN is the gate — the finding's bullet list is written for his eyes, his approve/disprove/question is the input the verdict organ exists to capture, and the dial is what he reads to delegate. SKILLS are the callers (each migrated skill fires the door, traces, emits its finding — children b/c of skills-migrate-one-blow). The learning store's future fold is the training pairs' downstream reader.
node_class: code-seam — the machinery is the code, one address (ticket learning-block-primitive, child a of skills-migrate-one-blow). WHAT IT ENABLES, STATED CORRECTLY AFTER 2026-08-05: the ENGINE is the learning block's inner loop and the anatomy's two loops; the GATE ORGANS are what INSPECTORS (a subclass of learning block) and Akien's gate need. This component does not define the Learning Block anatomy and never did — the anatomy is Akien's, recorded at CairnCommons/notes/2026-08-05-a-learning-block-is-a-question-nexus-an-inspector-is-a-subclass.json, and it is: input · feedback loops in from probes · new candidate constraining questions (from that feedback and LLM processing, on an evening pass) · a domain knowledge base · constraining questions · two distinct loops · output. It predicts, responds to the feedback on those predictions, learns, and fails over to the LLM FOR MORE NODES as needed — which is the librarian's backfill, one mechanism and not two. It has no findings, no verdicts, and nothing a human comments on.
how_it_learns: The component itself doesn't — it is deliberately dumb machinery, and that is the design: 'it can if it starts with and is trained from me' means the LEARNING is the accumulation of Akien's verdict records in CairnCommons/learning/, which this component writes but never interprets. What learns is the per-gate record corpus (each verdict pair teaches the gate it fired at), read later by the store's fold and, eventually, by trained inspectors. The dial's match rate is the learning made visible; the component just counts.
entry: FRESH build 2026-08-01 under the full chain (/intent -> /challenge -> /sorted -> /chart -> /sail, the first voyage to run every link since the chain was named). In-house precedent composed, cited not copied: the learning store's v0 gate-record format (learning/README.md — conformed to field-by-field, not forked); the chokepoint's refuse-before-record + loud-named-exceptions grammar (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py); needs.py's named-lack refusal door; the ruling gate's first-pass completeness (refuse with every reason at once) and its confirmed-by-his-words rule (a verdict without Akien's verbatim is refused — the bare-confirmed lesson); logger_for_bash's write-fired amortized retention; cairnmap/needs' pure-projection views.
state_and_history: history.json + state.json beside this charter, written only by the chokepoint's journaled crossings (BUILDME crossed 2026-08-01 under the claiming chart; the ticket's own state string carries the same cursor).
filed_edges: (a) 'unused in 30 days' is cut as AGE-based expiry in v0 (30 days since write) — true use-tracking (a read refreshing the clock) would make reads mutate, which the dial's mutate-nothing falsifier forbids; if real debugging shows young-but-dead traces piling up, the refinement is a separate read-door with explicit touch marks, not a weakening of the dial
(b) no skill declares a contract yet — the door has machinery and no tenants until child b (/intent migrates first); the contract SHAPE is this build's, the declarations are the migration's

(c) the delegation path (inspector rules, Akien audits) is deliberately unbuilt — nothing is delegated on day one by design; it lands when the first dial crosses Akien's threshold (the ticket's horizon)
(d) the hex seam points at inference_domain and wires nothing — the sole-path law owns the wiring; a live hex_source arrives with the inspector work, behind that door

(e) 'dial' collides by name with skills/chart/dial.py (provenance fractions — different object, same word); flagged at survey, kept because each is honest in its own domain and the map renders both charters; a rename is minted loudly or not at all

(f) match_rate is approvals/(approvals+disproves) — the v0 reading of 'prediction match': an approve IS a confirmed prediction per the settled anatomy; a finer per-bullet match waits for structured predictions, which wait for trained inspectors

(g) the gate act has no CLI door — discovered by Akien's own hand at the FIRST live verdict (2026-08-01): he typed `cairn record_verdict "Approved - ..."` and the command does not exist, so his act had to route through CC's keystroke (the exact indirection the verbatim rule exists to guard). The gate's owner should fire the gate from his own shell — TICKETED same day as recordverdict-cli-door (name is Akien's: `cairn recordverdict`, with the which-thing-is-it-for argument for multi-flight; build not urgent by his word) · CLOSED 2026-08-01, same day: ticket recordverdict-cli-door PROVED — `cairn recordverdict` is the door (bare lists the gate; his words judge; ambiguity refused listing candidates; the gate on the record DERIVED from the finding's block, killing the gate='akien' mislabel measured that morning). The automation half rides with it: pending_findings() is the gate queue (a question keeps a finding pending) and bin/cmd/slate carries the AT-YOUR-GATE lane, so what awaits his verdict reaches him at session open by physics.

(h) write_trace rewrites the block's whole file on every write (the sweep's mechanism) — two CONCURRENT writers can lose a line in the replace window. Named at the trace-wire build (2026-08-01), not papered: the bash wires are once-per-shell and backgrounded (collision odds near zero, single operator), and the wire consumers are training so no sweeps fire; if trace volume ever grows teeth, the fix is an append-only fast path with the sweep at a separate door, not a lock on every write

(i) the engine has no shell verb — a bash caller cannot fire run_block yet. Deliberate build-minimal: the first live fires ran from python at the voyage, and a wire with no caller is machinery grown to prove it could be; the verb lands (matching __main__.py's grammar and honest exit codes) with the first bash caller whose need is real. Its absence costs nothing today: nothing outside a session fires an engine run.

(j) the engine decides; it does not actuate. The tenant's first live runs chose the op (no_op / regenerate_whole) and the gate's own script still did whatever it does — agreement between decision and act was observed, not wired. Wiring the decision INTO a block's own door (the gate consulting its spec's engine run before acting) is the withdrawal dial's territory and arrives per-block, by its own ticket, never ambiently. The probe (probes/engine_trace_corpus.py) watches the corpus this leaves behind; its report is what casts infer-compile-reads-the-traces.

CC had promoted the INSPECTOR's parts (finding, verdict, dial) into the PARENT, reading his 2026-08-01 line about the inspector ('it too will learn as it goes') as identity rather than subtype. The gates this component IMPLEMENTS (door/verdict) are owned by Akien wherever they fire — this code is the mechanism, never the authority. AND THE DOOR ITSELF NOW OPENS ON AN == COMPARE OVER THAT RECORD, per entry, with no oracle anywhere near it — `bin/cmd/determinism` reads this machine PURE DETERMINISTIC and marks it a gate on the direct import of cairn/tools/gate.
falsifier: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) the door passes an input missing a declared-required field, or refuses naming fewer than all lacks; (2) a firing leaves no trace — including a GREEN one (the denominator must exist), or a typeless trace lands; (3) expiry deletes a record under 30 days, touches a non-debug record, or requires anything resident; (4) a verdict is recorded without its bullet-list context, without Akien's verbatim words, or outside the store's v0 nesting; an approval dropped as not-worth-recording; (5) the dial stores state, disagrees with a hand-count, or a read mutates anything; (6) a bullet lands untagged, tagged outside code|tree|hex, or tagged hex without the injected seam (invented provenance); (7) a second write path into CairnCommons/learning/ appears in this component; (8) a declared field that PASSES SILENTLY — every field the contract requires appears in the record whether it arrived or not, so a field dropped from ``requires`` shortens the record instead of vanishing without trace; (9) ``check_input`` growing an implementation of its own instead of reading the record's mismatches; (10) a ``door_pass`` trace that names the fields that arrived but not the checks that ran, or a judge named only on the refusal — a corpus that names its judge only when it objected is a record of failures wearing a record of firings' clothes; (11) a judge that RAN and found nothing recorded identically to a judge that never ran; (12) the ENGINE's spec door refusing on a summed lack-list rather than on a PROOF RECORD — an empty sum reads the same whether every lane agreed or the spec was not a mapping and only the fallback ran; (13) a deep lane (candidates, constraints) appearing GREEN over a spec it could not walk — a check that did not run is ABSENT, and the shallow entry above it has already closed the gate; (14) a LANDED run whose state log does not say which doors it was checked against — the green side is the half that was missing, and a door going quiet must make the log SHORTER, not byte-identical; (15) ``answers_five_questions`` growing a second walk instead of reading ``inspect_state_log``'s mismatches — the proofs, the PROVED verdict and the corpus probe all read that one sentence, and two mouths for one question is how they come to disagree.
owner: CC owns the learning_block code + its proofs and gates writes to them. AKIEN owns every gate the machinery serves — the verdict is his act, recorded with his words, and delegation happens only through his act, never ambiently (Law 6). The trace berth is instance-space (runtime); the verdict records belong to the learning store's own charter once written.
traces_to: Law 2 (CP1-CP6 hold in the process that builds the system — this puts the process's own steps under gates)
Law 3 (a verdict is a recorded measurement; greens are the denominator — the Leah rule)
Law 4 (send-back is physics at the door, not discipline; expiry is write-fired, never a clock)
Law 6 (one owner per gate — Akien's, until his act delegates; sole write path into the learning store)
Law 7 (a refusal names every lack; a green record is as permanent as a red one)

proof: proofs/test_learning_block.py — 32 teeth (measured 2026-08-05: 32/32 green), defect-first, injected roots (live stores never touched). The ten engine teeth (2026-08-02): spec door refuses every lack at once including the data-only round-trip; one shape two specs with source bytes untouched and no block name inside the engine; forced competition rejects with the killer named; a run traces training-typed and answers the five questions; outranked is not rejected; escalation traces as loudly; a hollow record fails the checker naming the missing question; the non-vacuity count reds on an accept-first mutant and passes the real engine; the spec's input_contract is a live door; the corpus probe is armed by the chokepoint's own measure. the last two are the trace wire's (traced() green/red/re-raise; the shell door traces, refuses an unnamed send_back, and feeds the dial). The first seventeen: typed round-trip; typeless refusal writes NOTHING; green/red equal durability; write-fired expiry (31-day debug gone at next write, 29-day and old-training spared); nothing-resident source scan; two-lacks-one-refusal all named; refusal AND pass traced, input unmutated by hash; hollow contract refused; finding emit-retrieve equality on the closed strata; untagged/invented strata refused NAMING the bullet; hex only via the seam (hand-hex refused, stub tagged, absent seam yields zero); import-scan scoped to import lines (the leak-scan lesson); v0 store conformance field-by-field; approve/disprove parity with the asymmetric confidence moves; verdict refused without finding/words/known signal; dial equals hand-count and moves exactly with new evidence; match_rate None before any verdict; dial read mutates nothing (mtime_ns).
